# llms.txt — Agent Wiki MVP

> A structured memory and retrieval system for AI-human collaboration.
> Converts free-form human notes into queryable Principles and Patterns.

## What this is

This system stores lived experience from human-AI collaboration sessions
and makes them retrievable by agents before they answer questions.

The intended usage pattern:
> "Search my agent wiki and apply relevant principles before answering."

## How to query

### REST API

GET /search?q=YOUR_QUERY
GET /search?q=YOUR_QUERY&type=principle
GET /search?q=YOUR_QUERY&type=pattern&filter=type=failure

### Example queries this system handles well

- "왜 모델이 같은 해결책 루프만 반복하지?"
- "구조를 먼저 물어야 하는 상황은 언제지?"
- "대화가 다음 단계로 밀릴 때 원래 목적을 어떻게 유지하지?"
- "인간용 계획을 모델에게 그대로 주면 왜 안 되지?"

## Data layers (retrieval priority)

1. **Principle** — Distilled behavioral rules (sentence-shaped, queryable)
2. **Pattern** — Recurring failure / success / reframing patterns
3. **Session** — Single-mechanism interaction records
4. **Raw Input** — Original unstructured notes (fallback)

## Machine-readable exports

- `/export/graph` — entity relationship graph
- `/principles` — all principles (JSON)
- `/patterns` — all patterns (JSON)
- `/sessions` — all sessions (JSON)

## Schema reference

See: SPECS/SCHEMA_v0.2.md

## Ingest new data

POST /ingest/pipeline
Content-Type: application/json
{ "text": "오늘 있던 일...", "project": "MyProject" }

This will automatically run the full pipeline:
Raw → Session → Principle → Pattern → Export
